gen-comfortaa-gf-mina: Neon-tube strokes and stretched spacing give Comfortaa its look, while Mina follows with simple sans lettering and gently unclosed round letters. Friendly roundness above, contemporary restraint below, nothing fighting for attention.
gen-comfortaa-gf-moderustic: Comfortaa's neon-tube strokes look bent from one gauge of glowing wire. It is built for round, outline-like display lettering, while Moderustic, in sans-serif dress, brings broad-nib curves left unfinished.
gen-comfortaa-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans leaves its letter openings wide as a door ajar, a quiet partner for Comfortaa's contrast-free headings. Mona Sans would carry paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-comfortaa-gf-murecho: Friendly and geometric, Comfortaa bends its display letters like tubing of one gauge. Murecho takes over where reading starts, its sans curves opening wide at both ends.
gen-comfortaa-gf-national-park: Comfortaa's strokes look drawn in neon tube, stretched and round. National Park keeps a pen's pressure and angle constant, letting its sans text sit quietly beneath those glowing display curves.
gen-comfortaa-gf-niramit: Niramit reads crisp and professional, its curves gaping open instead of pinching shut. And its text would stay smooth paragraph after paragraph, under Comfortaa's friendly headings drawn flat like fineliner.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Comfortaa draws friendly, geometric display forms with a ballpoint's pressure-free line, while Noto Sans Cypriot lets its e open up. One is made to be noticed, the other to be read.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Comfortaa's strokes look made with a fixed-width stencil brush, while Noto Sans Hatran gives its e a wide funnel throat. Friendly geometry above, approachable sans text below, nothing clashing.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Comfortaa shows no visible difference between up and side strokes, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps every small counter unclogged. Comfortaa is happiest in large, brief bursts of friendly geometry.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Comfortaa's letters look drawn by a fixed-width nib, geometric and friendly, with spacing stretched like an uncoiled spring. And Noto Sans Linear A answers by leaving its c visibly gaping at any size.
